youtube_description:
http://wavegenetics.org/en  
Professor of Biology Peter Garyaev is the founding father of wave genetics — a truly revolutionary theory in modern science that can hugely benefit the whole of humanity. It can help cure any type of diseases, regenerate any organs and, consequently, make us young forever and help us live longer than we've ever dared to wish. 
Peter Garyaev's wave genetics also shows us that some of the allegedly beneficial and helpful things such as medical ultrasonography, in fact, harm our bodies tremendously. 
In this video Peter Garyaev tells about one of his experiments conducted within his wave genetics studies. What does ultrasound really do to our bodies, to our DNAs, to us? It turns out, that it, basically, destroys the DNA. In normal conditions, the DNA produces a complex musical melody with intrinsic phrasing pattern. And exposing the DNA to ultrasound erases an enormous amount of genetic information from it. Ultrasound, as it were, deafens and dumbs down your DNA: its wave matrices become so shattered that there is only one frequency in it, only one monotonous note that can be heard. After being irradiated by diagnostic sonography the DNA generates only what Piotr Garyaev calls a wave phantom of pain and fear. 
And since this harmful procedure — diagnostic ultrasound — is so widespread, because every pregnant woman wants to have a sonogram, there are no healthy kids on our planet. Think about it. Our ignorance about wave matrices of our DNAs and about wave genetics in general has severely jeopardized the genome of the whole of humanity. The works of Peter Garyaev can help us change this situation. We only need to listen more carefully to the waves of our DNAs.
